notes: Cliopatria has no Mapungubwe. One page (the state's article) was opened under the 1-2 page budget for a state with no Cliopatria shapes. The page dates only the move to Mapungubwe Hill (c. 1220) and the abandonment (c. 1300); the earlier sacral kingship at Mapela Hill ('nearly 200 years earlier') and the K2/Schroda phases (from c. 900-1000) are not drawn as a state because the infobox starts the kingdom at c. 1220. Area: infobox and text give 30,000 km2 with no year (text attaches it to the 1250 population figure); the outline is a 98 km disc around the hill, not the page's frontier. The Venda rulers in the infobox (Shiriyadenga, Tshidziwelele) are 'according to some Venda traditions' and are not entered as a ruler strip. The successor link to kingdom-of-zimbabwe is political, not territorial: the basin was abandoned. Gazetteer: all names resolve (place Mapungubwe).
